source_info.reference: Krizhevsky, Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images, 2009

feature_extractor: ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1, fc removed, frozen (identical to Notebook 04a)
pool_definition: official train partition, split 60/20/20 stratified, seed 42 (CIFAR-10N labels exist only for the train partition)

pairflip.justification: cat vs dog, automobile vs truck, and deer vs horse are canonical visually/semantically confusable CIFAR-10 pairs.
